name: flight-brief
title: Flight brief
for_each: select id,code from trips where status in ('planned','confirmed') order by code

sections.title: Legs (UTC)
sections.sql: select l.seq,l.dep,l.arr,to_char(l.std at time zone 'UTC','HH24:MI') std,l.pax from legs l where l.trip_id=$1 order by l.seq

sections.title: Before this trip goes
sections.note: Every problem the records show. The pilot in command makes the go decision.
sections.sql: select coalesce(nullif(problems,''),'None recorded') problems from v_schedule s join trips t on t.code=s.code where t.id=$1

name: passenger-manifest
title: Passenger manifest
for_each: select id,code from trips where status<>'cancelled' order by code

sections.title: Flight
sections.sql: select code,flight_date,aircraft,aircraft_type,pic_name pilot,route,pax from v_trips where trip_id=$1

sections.title: Passengers
sections.note: Check the manifest fields your operator exposition requires before using this as your record.
sections.sql: select name,weight_kg,bags_kg from passengers where trip_id=$1 order by name

name: journey-log
title: Journey log
for_each: select id,code from trips where status='flown' order by code

sections.title: Trip
sections.sql: select code,flight_date,aircraft,aircraft_type,pic_name pilot,client from v_trips where trip_id=$1

sections.title: Sectors (UTC)
sections.sql: select seq,dep,arr,off_utc,on_utc,block_hours,air_hours,landings,pax,fuel_l from v_legs where trip=(select code from trips where id=$1) order by seq

name: charter-quote
title: Charter quote
for_each: select id,code from quotes where status in ('draft','sent') order by code

sections.title: Your flight
sections.sql: select q.code quote,cl.name client,q.flight_date,q.route,q.pax passengers,a.type aircraft,q.est_hours estimated_hours,q.rate hourly_rate,q.extras,q.price total,q.valid_until from quotes q join clients cl on cl.id=q.client_id join aircraft a on a.id=q.aircraft_id where q.id=$1

name: crew-record
title: Pilot hours and currency
for_each: select id,code from crew where role='pilot' order by code

sections.title: Duty periods, last 28 days (UTC)
sections.sql: select kind,starts,ends,duty_hours,rest_before_hours from v_duties v join crew c on c.code=v.crew where c.id=$1 and v.start_at>=now()-interval '28 days' order by v.start_at
